answer: Group attestations into per-epoch cohorts: every vouch lands on one wharf and the signers' bonds are joint, sized to the cohort's total weight. One proof that any member is a clone slashes an escalating fraction from every co-signer at that wharf and forces the survivors to re-derive fresh per-head inference before vouching again. Cost lands per identity, as each bond tracks the cohort joined: a farm stacking fifty clones on one wharf makes one detection fifty times dearer. If joint bonds are skipped, each edge is an isolated ledge, cheap to fake, with no thread back to the ring.
